jobs.title: Senior Interoperability Digital Product Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
The Sr. Manager of Digital Product Management is the owner of all facets of their product and must be adept at working across all phases of product management. Entrepreneurial by nature, this person is accustomed to taking ambiguous products and turning them into well run operations that create meaningful value both for the customer and the company. With a strong background as a Digital Product Manager, this person will both help to define the product management function, and through their performance help elevate Quest to best in class. Willingness to roll up their sleeves and dive into the details, while simultaneously able to craft stories for executive and customer presentation is a must.
Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.
Benefits Information: We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:
- Day 1 Medical, supplemental health, dental & vision for FT employees who work 30+ hours
- Best-in-class well-being programs
- Annual, no-cost health assessment program
- Blueprint for Wellness
- healthyMINDS mental health program
- Vacation and Health/Flex Time
- 6 Holidays plus 1 MyDay off
- FinFit financial coaching and services
- 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth IRA with company match up to 5% after 12 months of service
- Employee stock purchase plan
- Life and disability insurance, plus buy-up option
- Flexible Spending Accounts Annual incentive plans
- Matching gifts program
-  Education assistance through MyQuest for Education Career advancement opportunities and so much more!
Required Work Experience:
5+ years product management required
Preferred Work Experience:
3 years healthcare experience
Lab experience preferred
2+ years Product Management experience Preferred
Education
- Bachelor’s Degree BS in Comp Science (Preferred)
- Master’s Degree MBA (Preferred)
- Strategic and delivery leader for core interoperability orders and results solutions and supporting analysis, implementation, self-service, and automation tools.

- Set vision and develop strategy, define and deliver optimized client and partner experiences throughout the orders and results interface journey

- Deliver high quality HL7 and FHIR interfaces for core orders and results, both inbound and outbound interfaces.

- Partner on new test products, specialized integration solutions, new EHR certification and validations, focusing on simplified integrations, reduced level of effort, driving time to market and reduced turn-around time.

- Partner with the Business to confirm understanding of customer need, align on scope, manage a roadmap and related financials, and regularly prioritize product development efforts.

- Regularly collect and analyze the Voice of the Customer, industry trends, disruptors, and current competition.

- Ensure comprehensive competitive information on market penetration, product capabilities and initiatives are maintained.

- Understand Quest clients by leading research stakeholder feedback, customer feedback, benchmarking, and journey mapping to develop deep understanding of clients' needs and inform client attraction, engagement, and retention.

- Translate overall vision into product roadmap and delivery; evangelize solutions to associated teams and partners

- Regularly present product strategy, roadmap progress, and performance metrics to senior leadership and executive steering committees to secure buy-in and resources.

- Accountable for the results of the Digital products assigned; Assess long-term viability of product features aligned to expected business outcomes and benefits, building opportunities to maintain or improve Quest's competitive position.

- Provide input on business plans/initiatives/marketing programs, to drive sales effectiveness, operational efficiency, and strategic congruence.

- Own end-to-end digital and data journeys; Work with the Design Team to inform User Experiences, Wireframes, prototypes, customer journeys, personas, corresponding data journeys and content that bring the journeys and product strategies to life.

- Collaborates with business partners on the creation of business cases and serves as two-in-a-box with the Business Owner to manage the product digital and related data lifecycles / journeys.

- Accountable for the definition/refinement of the backlog of Epics and related Features to enable Agile ARTs to deliver prioritized business value.

- Proactively identify short- and long-term product/process improvement, bring forward innovative ideas and opportunities as part of collaboration with the team, leads and key business partner.

- Promote an environment that encourages collaboration, initiative, continuous improvement, learning and the generation of innovative ideas and solutions.

- Manage existing solutions and data. Identify and manage solutions and related data within the domains of improving member satisfaction, utilization management and risk arrangements.

- Work with Interoperability Vendor Management team to define and track strategic interoperability opportunities with key EHR partners.

- Mentor and guide digital product manager and digital product analysts on the team.

- Lead cross-functional teams to drive product strategy and execution.

- Act as a subject matter expert for interoperability within the organizationn.

Required:
- - 10 or more years of Product Management with progressive responsibilities.

- - 8 or more years of experience in healthcare interoperability, including experience with HL7 and FHIR interfaces.

- - 5 or more years of experience in Agile ways of working and related product management.

- - 5 or more years of experience with client implementations and delivering interoperability solutions.

- - 5 or more years utilizing design thinking.

- - Demonstrated experience in setting product vision and strategy.

- Preferred:

- - Scaled Agile (SAFe) Product Management certification or experience.

- - Experience in healthcare interoperability in a lab setting.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Women's Health
jobs.description:
We Provide Solutions. Patients and Physicians rely on our diagnostic testing, information, and services to help them make better healthcare decisions. These are often serious decisions with far reaching consequences, and require sensitivity, tact, and a clear dedication to service. It’s about providing clarity and hope.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work for the world leader in the industry, with a career where you can expand your skills and knowledge. You’ll have a role where you can act with professionalism, you can inspire colleagues, and you can care about the work we do and the people we serve.

The Senior Product Manager will lead new solution development, life cycle management and test reimbursement strategies for the Genital Tract Infections (GTI) product segment by collaborating with cross-functional teams. You will advocate and prioritize business cases to the segment Senior Product Director and win support to execute strategies through commercial, marketing and the value-delivery organization.
Required Work Experience:

Preferred Work Experience:
- Knowledge of and experience in specified product segment preferred

Education:
- Requires Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, marketing and/or product management.
- Advanced degree (e.g. MBA) preferred

Knowledge:
- Understanding of the lab industry and Women’s Health testing landscape

Travel
- Up to 15% (Domestic)

Skills:
- Influencing without authority
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Action Oriented
- Analytical Skills
- Critical Thinking
- Learning Agility
- Perseverance
- Plans & Aligns
- Communicate effectively
- Drives Results
- Execute various stages of product management and contribute to strategic planning for clinical focus areas

- Lead cross functional teams to identify, develop and implement product/solutions addressing unmet customer needs that will drive profitable growth

- Develop segment annual Operating Plan (AOP) in concert with Value Delivery partners

- Execute effective life-cycle management through robust cross-functional team management

- Work with Value Delivery partners to achieve revenue targets

- Partner with Marketing on product/solution marketing strategy and mix

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Core Infectious Disease
jobs.description:

In this role, you will own your P&L and be responsible for the success and direction of your portfolio.
The Director will lead a team of 2 Associate Product Managers.   People development, cross functional collaboration and strategic execution in a complex, matrix environment are skills paramount to success in this role.   The Director will also maintain relationships and opportunistically collaborate with external organizations and partners.
The ideal candidate possesses a strong executive presence and is a clear and concise communicator capable of engaging with both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Director, Product Operations - Workforce Health Solutions
jobs.description:
The Director of Product Operations – WHS leads the commercialization, operational enablement, and lifecycle management for Quest’s Workforce Health Solutions product portfolio across both the Workplace Drug Screening (OHS) and Employer Population Health (EPH) segments. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Product Development – WHS, this leader acts as the operational execution head of the product organization, managing a team of specialized Product Managers to translate business strategy into scalable, profitable solutions.

The Director oversees the end-to-end product value chain—spanning physical kit logistics, clinical laboratory integration, digital reporting, and platform connectivity. By establishing robust operational infrastructure, standardizing cross-functional support processes, and defining clear SLAs, this leader bridges the gap between product development, internal business units, and daily commercial operations. Through close collaboration with sales, IT (HTAS), clinical operations, and regulatory affairs, they ensure the portfolio achieves annual operating plan (AOP) objectives, maximizes operating margins, and delivers a seamless client experience.
Required Work Experience:

- 8+ years of progressive product management, product development, or operational leadership experience in healthcare, clinical diagnostics, workplace safety, or B2B2C corporate wellness.

- At least 2–3 years of direct people management experience, ideally leading product management or cross-functional project teams.

- Demonstrated track record of scaling digital platforms, managing physical product logistics, or launching complex B2B services.

Preferred Work Experience:

- Familiarity with occupational health services, clinical toxicology/drug screening, or laboratory information systems (LIS).

- Experience working in a highly regulated industry (FDA, DOT, SAMHSA, CAP/CLIA).

- Experience using Lean management principles, Agile/Scrum methodologies, or structured process-improvement tools.

Technical/Job Specific Knowledge:

- Strong familiarity with agile software development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

- Solid financial acumen; ability to model product profitability, evaluate pricing models, and analyze P&L components.

- Understanding of digital integration protocols (APIs, HL7 data flows) and platform interfaces.

- Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Outlook, Excel, SharePoint.

Skills:

- Extremely strong written and oral communication and excellent influencing/collaboration skills across many functions and levels

- Demonstrated ability to independently lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives.

- Analytical skills, including the ability to analyze financial, volume, and market data

Work Environment:

- Hybrid work environment, in the office minimum 3 days per week.

- Travel Required

- English Required

Education:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. (Required)

- Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master of Public Health (MPH). (Preferred)
- Standardize Operational Playbooks: Establish, codify, and scale operational processes, customer onboarding playbooks, and service-level agreements (SLAs) across both lines of business.

- Full Portfolio Lifecycle Management:  Oversee the end-to-end development lifecycles of all core products—from receipt of validated innovation concepts to commercialization, scaling, continuous optimization, and eventual portfolio rationalization.

- Operational Integration & Excellence:  Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Lab Administration, Logistics, and Customer Service to optimize end-to-end workflows. Define, track, and report onkey performance indicators (KPI’s) regarding platform stability, feature utilization, support resolution times and business unit readiness. Solve operational friction points and improve product scalability using structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., STP).

- Platform & Digital Strategy Execution:  Coordinate with technical, development, and support teams to manage and optimize the interface of OHS and EPH services with broader Quest digital platforms. Ensure robust data flow, automated reporting, and modern digital toolsets.

- Financial & Margin Management:  Support the Sr. Director in achieving division-wide AOP revenue, volume, and margin targets. Actively manage portfolio pricing, identify cost-reduction opportunities, and drive operating margin (OM) expansion.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Lead large, matrixed squads (comprising IT/HTAS, Legal, Compliance, Sales Operations, and Brand Marketing) to ensure product and feature rollouts are executed on-time, within budget, and in full compliance with regulatory requirements. Partner with marketing and clinical operations to design strategies that increase participant engagement on MyHQ and portal utilization across ESP and QTN.

- Strategic Business Partnership: Act as the primary interface between senior Quest Business Unit (BU) leaders, clinical operations, sales executives, and the Product Development team.

- Regulatory & Quality Oversight:  Ensure all products, collection methods, and platform integrations comply with applicable healthcare and workplace safety laws (e.g., DOT and non-DOT screening protocols, HIPAA, GINA, and clinical lab standards).

- Commercial Enablement:  Collaborate with Commercial Sales and Brand Marketing to develop persuasive, market-facing value propositions, launch tools, and technical documentation. Support the sales team during strategic client interactions or program-end business reviews.

- People Management: Direct, mentor, and coach a growing team of Senior Managers and Product Support Specialists. Create culture of operational excellence, accountability, and user experience.

- Resource Optimization: Strategically allocate operational and support resources across the Population Health and Occupational Health portfolios to balance business unit needs and demands.

- Career Pathing: Define performance metrics, technical training pathways, and career development plans for members of the Product Operations organization.

jobs.title: Digital Product Analyst
jobs.description:
This role is a critical piece in our Product organization that helps to translate strategy into action as we work to make the digital experience at Quest universally lovable for all of our constituents.  We believe that a passion for enjoyable experiences is core to helping us achieve our goals, which in turn will lead to new growth opportunities for Quest to explore.

The Digital Product Analyst, Interoperability will be responsible for defining, developing, and executing strategies to integrate and scale healthcare interoperability products, channels, and API data exchanges. In this role, you will analyze complex clinical data workflows, conduct market and EHR-vendor research, and couple these insights with internal technical mapping to propose innovative, scalable connectivity solutions for our partners, physicians, and health systems.

Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Interface Engineers, and Software Developers, the Senior Analyst acts as a critical bridge to bring high-impact data exchange features to life, accelerating clinical integrations, electronic health record (EHR) partner onboarding, and strategic client migrations.
Education
- Required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. Equivalent, highly relevant work experience can substitute for the degree.

Required Work Experience
- Required: 3+ years of digital product analysis, healthcare IT analyst, or interface engineering experience.
- Required: At least 1–2 years of direct experience working on healthcare interoperability solutions (such as clinical interface engines, laboratory integrations, or EMR/EHR interfaces).

Preferred Work Experience
- Demonstrated success handling complex client-facing software migrations or vendor integrations.
- Hands-on experience working directly with major EMR/EHR platforms (e.g., Epic, Cerner, OncoEMR) and digital health integration networks.
- Experience navigating clinical lab networks or specialty diagnostic platforms (e.g., Precision Oncology, Pathology workflows).

Knowledge & Technical Expertise
- Standards & Protocols: Strong knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards (HL7 v2/v3, FHIR, JSON APIs, XML, and C-CDA).
- Lab Workflows: Firm understanding of clinical lab operations, computerized physician order entry (CPOE), and structured lab results delivery.
- Agile Frameworks: In-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies, product owner responsibilities, and sprint management.
- Change Management: High awareness of change management practices when transitioning clinical users to new systems or data networks.

Skills
- Analytical Thinking: Exceptional capability to dissect complex datasets, identify clinical data elements, map system schemas, and produce actionable integration recommendations.
- Interpersonal & Communication: Stellar verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to explain deep technical integrations to business stakeholders, and complex business workflows to developers.
- Business Process Mapping (BPM): Deep proficiency in visual business process mapping, workflow charting, and detailing clinical system integration touchpoints.
- Analytical Toolsets: Advanced experience utilizing data modeling, reporting, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel pivot tables, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or workflow visualization software).
- Self-Direction: Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of operating independently to drive projects to completion while maintaining close alignment with core product goals.
Interoperability Strategy & Analysis
- Data Flow & Workflow Analysis: Lead the mapping, analysis, and optimization of complex clinical data flows (e.g., orders, discrete results, genomic data) across internal laboratory information systems (LIS) and external EMR/EHR platforms.
- EHR Integration & Onboarding: Partner with primary EHR vendors and healthcare networks to analyze integration capabilities, define connectivity requirements, and support strategic client migration or transition initiatives.
- Industry Standards Advocacy: Keep abreast of emerging healthcare interoperability guidelines, national standards, and regulations (such as HL7, FHIR, JSON APIs, and HIPAA) to ensure digital products remain leading-edge and compliant.
- Adoption & Growth Analytics: Conduct research and utilize analytical tools to monitor how healthcare providers interact with digital connectivity channels; identify factors that drive product adoption, integration speed, and clinical customer engagement.

Product Delivery & Agile Execution
- Backlog Management & Story Writing: Write highly descriptive features and user stories centered on technical integrations, API requirements, and system interfaces, aligning with the "Definition Ready" and "Definition of Done."
- Agile Collaboration: Guide agile software engineering and interface squads through story refinement, daily standups, and release planning.
- Technical Roadmapping: Support Product Managers in prioritizing and detailing the interoperability product roadmap, using customer-centric design to minimize implementation barriers.

Collaboration & Innovation
- Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate cross-functionally with technical writers, data scientists, security experts, and business partners to design highly scalable, highly secure data transmission infrastructures.
- External Partner Liaison: Collaborate with third-party digital health networks, clinical databases, and external technology consultants to build seamless data bridges.
- Best Practices Leadership: Institutionalize best practices for interface implementation and digital product support, helping the organization transition from legacy integration processes to modern, scalable frameworks.
